faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Go to My Orders, pick your order and tap Track. You will also get a tracking link by email and SMS once the order ships.

faqs.question: How can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel from My Orders > Cancel Order until the order is shipped. After shipping, refuse delivery or start a return instead.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Most items can be returned within 10 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging. Start a return from My Orders > Return.

faqs.question: When will I get my refund?
keywords: money to come back to my account
how many days for money to return
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item. The money goes back to your original payment method.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-7 business days. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days in major cities.

faqs.question: What are the shipping charges?
faqs.answer: Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 499. Below that, a flat fee of Rs. 40 applies.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Not yet. We currently deliver only within India. International shipping is planned for later this year.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, popular wallets and Cash on Delivery.

faqs.question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Do not worry. Failed payments are auto-refunded in 3-5 business days. If you do not get it by then, contact support with your transaction ID.

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
faqs.answer: Yes, COD is available on orders up to Rs. 5,000 at most pin codes. You will see the option at checkout if your address is eligible.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: On the login page tap Forgot Password, enter your email or phone number, and follow the link or OTP we send you.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Tap Sign Up, enter your name, email and phone number, verify the OTP, and set a password. It takes under a minute.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
faqs.answer: You can change the address from My Orders until the order is packed. After that, contact support and we will try to update it with the courier.

faqs.question: I received a damaged or wrong item. What now?
faqs.answer: Sorry about that. Report it within 48 hours from My Orders > Report an Issue with a photo. We will send a replacement or refund you.

faqs.question: Do products come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: Electronics carry the manufacturer warranty, shown on the product page. Keep your invoice because you need it to claim warranty.

faqs.question: How do I download my invoice?
faqs.answer: Open My Orders, select the order and tap Download Invoice. GST invoices are available once the order is delivered.

faqs.question: How do I apply a promo code?
faqs.answer: Enter the code in the Apply Coupon box on the cart page. Check that your cart meets the minimum value and the code has not expired.

faqs.question: Do you sell gift cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, gift cards from Rs. 500 to Rs. 10,000 are available. Redeem them at checkout by entering the card code.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: Email support@shopease.example or call 1800-000-000 (toll free). You can also use Help > Chat with us in the app.

faqs.question: What are your customer support hours?
faqs.answer: Support is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM IST. Email is monitored round the clock.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account and data?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Your data is removed within 30 days, except records we must keep for tax purposes.

faqs.question: Do you offer EMI options?
faqs.answer: Yes, EMI is available on orders above Rs. 3,000 with selected credit cards. Choose EMI at checkout to see plans.

faqs.question: My order has not arrived yet. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check the latest status in My Orders > Track. If it is past the delivery date, contact support with your order ID and we will chase the courier.

faqs.question: Can I exchange a product for a different size or colour?
faqs.answer: Yes, exchanges are allowed within 10 days for clothing and footwear, subject to stock. Choose Exchange in My Orders.

faqs.question: What if an item is out of stock?
faqs.answer: Tap Notify Me on the product page and we will email you as soon as it is back in stock.
